dict.string: VOCA needs Accessibility permission to listen for global hotkeys and type text into other apps when you stop recording.

VOCA needs microphone access to record your voice for speech-to-text transcription. Your selected speech service determines where audio is processed. Local models process audio on this Mac; Apple Speech may use Apple services.
VOCA uses Automation to pause Music or Spotify during dictation and resume the same track afterward, only when you enable this feature.
VOCA uses Apple Speech to transcribe your voice. Depending on availability, Apple may process audio on this Mac or through its speech service.
